_readme: Literal deny-list for the classes that cannot be published as patterns.
Copy this file to config/literals.json and replace the fictional entries with
your own. config/literals.json is path-guarded in .gitignore and can never be
committed. The scanner fails closed if this file is missing or unparsable —
Separator expansion: '-', '_' and space inside a literal are compiled to
[\s\-_]* , so 'acme-tek' matches acmetek / acme tek / acme_tek / AcmeTek.
exclude_compounds: use when a literal is also an ordinary word. The literal
still hits on its own; it is suppressed only inside the enumerated compounds.
The third d_person_literal entry below shows the shape: a surname that is
also a common noun, suppressed inside the compounds where it cannot be a
name, and still caught when it stands alone.
positive_control: a payload that MUST match this class. The test suite
re-matches it against the compiled patterns, so the control cannot rot into a
no-op when a literal is edited.

c_customer_literal.declared_empty_reason: the example configuration ships no customer list; customer names are still reachable through the c7 company/honorific markers, but literal coverage for this class is zero and is reported on every run
